seoTitle: Create a Questionnaire in Smartsheet Using Forms
metaDescription: Build a questionnaire in Smartsheet with structured columns, the Form builder, conditional logic, and automated notifications for new submissions.
intro: A questionnaire needs more structure than a basic form, and Smartsheet's grid-plus-Form combination handles that well. This guide covers setting up your response columns, activating the Form builder, adding conditional question logic, and tracking submission trends afterward.

steps.heading: Build your questionnaire sheet
steps.body: Create a master sheet and set up your core submission tracking layout.

steps.heading: Define your question columns
steps.body: Use Contact Lists, Single-Select Dropdowns, Multi-Select Picklists, and Text fields to organize each question type.

steps.heading: Activate the Form Builder
steps.body: Turn your grid columns into a polished, user-friendly questionnaire layout.

steps.heading: Add conditional logic and requirements
steps.body: Mark required fields and set up logic that shows or hides questions based on a respondent's previous answers.

steps.heading: Set up notifications and track trends
steps.body: Configure automated workflows to notify your team on new submissions, and use the Sheet Summary panel to track volumes and demographics.

faq.question: Can questions change based on how someone answers earlier ones?
faq.answer: Yes, conditional logic lets you show or hide specific questions dynamically based on a respondent's previous answers.

faq.question: What column types work best for questionnaire questions?
faq.answer: Contact Lists, Single-Select Dropdowns, Multi-Select Picklists, and Text fields each suit different question formats.

faq.question: Will my team be notified of new responses automatically?
faq.answer: Yes, automated workflows can be set up to instantly notify your team when a new questionnaire is completed.

faq.question: Can I see overall response trends?
faq.answer: The Sheet Summary panel and visual charts let you track total submission volumes and respondent demographics at a glance.
